Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (28)

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` a6: ref/verify says 'both owners named'; the ambiguity case asserts only messageOf(res) toContain('crm_account')
- `api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` a5: ledger-reach asserts the key set via rows.find, never that exactly one row exists, and does not read the 200 body {name, objectName, enabled}
- `api-backend.action-activation-door-contract` a2: ref claims 'unknown-key/non-boolean 400s' — pin asserts code VALIDATION_FAILED only, not fields[0] unknown_field/invalid_type or the non-object-body arm
- `api-backend.bulk-write-contract` ref '(bulk halves)' overclaims: the pin's bulk cases call ql.update/ql.delete({multi:true}) on the engine with a resolved authz context; none of the createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP doors the clauses name is driven, so no clause a0-a5/n0 is asserted
- `api-backend.bulk-write-contract` a3: packages/rest/src/rest-batch-size-cap.test.ts pins BATCH_TOO_LARGE at the unit layer (mock protocol) and is not in this item's ref; it still would not score an api oracle
- `api-backend.data-request-shape-and-query-arity` a1-a4: every pin invokes RestServer route handlers / HttpDispatcher.dispatch directly (real ObjectQL+SqlDriver for data-write-request-gate, data-delete-expected-version, data-conflict-caller-visibility; stubs for the arity files) — none boots the Hono adapter, so the api-oracle clauses stay a live leg
- `api-backend.data-request-shape-and-query-arity` a1: the empty-version-token leg is in data-delete-expected-version.test.ts (DELETE), while the clause speaks of PATCH bodies + an empty version token — check the clause intends DELETE for the token
- `api-backend.declarative-endpoint-execution` a1: no pin asserts the 401 body's code (UNAUTHENTICATED); showcase case checks success:false only, policy case status only
- `api-backend.declarative-endpoint-execution` a2: spec gate (a) asserts the fix sentence but not that the message names the endpoint; the #5488 runtime-authoring withdrawal is unasserted; the build oracle's os validate/os build run is not a pin
- `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` a1: the verify names rest-hook-script-fault-envelope.test.ts for the 'live /data door' — that file imports mapDataError only, so the live leg is unit, not the door
- `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` a2: dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts uses a real engine + SqlDriver behind HttpDispatcher; no Hono adapter, so the wire body is the dispatcher's result, not an HTTP answer
- `api-backend.meta-read-doors-v18` a4: no ref pin asserts the data-sort 403 on F (the 'two agree' half); showcase-fls-read-mask-strip.dogfood.test.ts has a sort-403 case but is not in this ref
- `api-backend.meta-read-doors-v18` a1-a3: precedent #24840 carried these as pass from #24779; on this tree every ref pin drives route handlers with a stub server/response (no Hono adapter), so they score a0 only
- `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` a0: dogfood asserts status 409 and text toMatch(/ACTION_DISABLED|is disabled/) — neither the exact code nor the describeDisabledAction sentence, and no task re-read for side effects; the exact sentence is unit-only (action-activation-dispatch.test.ts › the shared guard itself › answers 409 ACTION_DISABLED with the ENGINE's own sentence)
- `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` a3/a6/n1: ref credits action-activation-dispatch.test.ts for the 403-not-an-oracle, flow-type and absence-means-active legs, but it is a unit HttpDispatcher over fakes — it stops above the HTTP layer the api oracle needs
- `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` a5: ref correctly says the restart leg stays manual
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` a4: engine.test.ts '[#2850] routes the expand sub-read through the middleware … tagged __expandRead' proves the sub-read is routed through middleware on a mock driver — not that a contributor's expand withholds the contact over HTTP; under rule 6 it cannot score a4 (round 4 #24840 scored it pass)
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` n0: request-schema-gate.conformance.test.ts drives RestServer with a mocked protocol — the ref says so itself
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` whole item: Tier 1 in name only — no clause has a pin at its oracle's layer
- `api-backend.rest-batch-config-contract` a5: rest-sub-config-parse-not-cast.test.ts §E › 'refuses `batch.operations.upsertMany` and `batch.defaultAtomic`' asserts the key and /never built/ resp. /options.atomic/; it does not assert that the messages name BatchEndpointsConfigSchema, nor the upsert replacement (an operation type of the generic batch door)
- `api-backend.rest-crud-config-contract` a3: packages/rest/src/discovery-services-route-follows-mount.test.ts ('#16674 — a moved `crud.dataPrefix` moves BOTH halves of the document') pins the discovery-advertisement half at a non-default prefix and is not in the ref; the moved-route-table half has no pin.
- `api-backend.rest-crud-config-contract` a4: ref says §E pins acceptance[4]; the case asserts 'crud.patterns' + 'CrudEndpointsConfigSchema' + /was removed in @objectstack\/spec 17/ only — the declarative-api-endpoint prescription is never matched, and the objectParamStyle refusal is checked for its key and /was removed/ only.
- `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract` a1: ref says §D 'pins prefix … survival' — true, but no pin mounts at prefix '/metadata' or reads the discovery body's routes.metadata; the clause's move-together claim is unpinned
- `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract` a5: §E's cacheTtl case asserts the key, MetadataEndpointsConfigSchema and /was removed/; the endpoints.schema case asserts the key and /does not exist/ only — neither asserts the replacement named in the verify
- `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract` a3: only the normalizeConfig half is pinned; ref concedes the masking-effect half has no pin
- `api-backend.rest-route-generation-tombstones` a0: §E › 'refuses every `routes.*` key' asserts `routes.<key>`, RouteGenerationConfigSchema and /was removed/ — not the clause's 'was removed in @objectstack/spec 17'; nameTransform driven with 'none' only (ref concedes)

### From #25817 — `release-18.2.0-manual-set`, 29 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix`: The #24618 negative-offset shift no longer reproduces; the item text can say it is fixed.
- api-backend.formula-stdlib-matrix steps[5] / requires[1]: a scratch object without `sharingModel` gets 422 `security-owd-unset`. The step should say to declare one.

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
